title: Nutty Velvety Syrian Cheese Salad
description: A creamy, nutty Syrian-inspired salad that blends toasted pine nuts, crisp cucumbers, and velvety grated Parmesan for a kid-friendly lunch.
instructions: Wash and dice the cucumber, and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Crumbled the feta cheese and grated the Parmesan cheese.
In a small dry skillet, toast the pine nuts over medium heat for 4–5 minutes, stirring constantly, until golden and fragrant; transfer to a plate to cool.
In a large bowl, combine the cucumber, tomatoes, feta, Parmesan, and toasted pine nuts.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, honey (if using), a pinch of sumac, salt, and pepper to create a dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and gently toss until all ingredients are evenly coated.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 2 hours for a chilled option.
